race.title: Virgin Bet Training Series Final Apprentice Handicap (Div 2)
race.verdict: This looks wide open. BEAUTY CHOICE did well to overcome traffic problems when going in at Redcar recently and is taken to defy a 3 lb higher mark at the chief expense of Golden Strike who bids for a fourth victory of 2026 on the back of his latest York success. Last year's victor Lir Speciale can also have a big say too if shrugging off a lesser effort here last time. King's School completes the shortlist. BEAUTY CHOICE GOLDEN STRIKE (IRE) LIR SPECIALE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Golden Strike (9/2), Irish Nectar (5/1), Thunder Roar (6/1), King's School (6/1), Lir Speciale (7/1), On The River (8/1), Beauty Choice (10/1), Bridget's View (10/1), Intrusively (10/1), We Dare To Dream (16/1), Raatea (33/1), Bowood (33/1)
